reason: A modular DSH Web UI extension suite focused on navigation panels and interface customization, with additional task automation, Git visualization, remote access, SSH operations, image understanding, and skins.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供可插拔的导航面板、任务看板、Git 可视化、远程访问、SSH 运维、图像理解工具和主题皮肤。
summaries.en: A modular DSH Web UI suite providing navigation panels, task boards, Git visualization, remote access, SSH operations, image understanding, and customizable skins.

capabilities: Adds configurable Web UI panels and skins
Provides a multi-column task board with scheduled agent execution
Displays Git branches and commit history visually
Supports paired remote access from mobile and PC browsers
Provides SSH terminals, file transfer, port forwarding, and clustered command execution
Sends images to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for description
